goal: Fast Cloud Deduplication on Post-Restart Drop, Notification De-Spamming, and Dispatcher Unfreezing
acceptanceCriteria: 1. When user drops files (e.g. 100 files) after an interrupted transfer (e.g. 85 completed), files already present in the cloud matching name, format, and exact byte size are skipped immediately without re-transferring.
2. Cloud deduplication performs O(1) checks against local deduplication ledger and direct virtual drive mount (<1ms per file) without crawling directory trees.
3. Support PSCustomObject account deserialization in Test-RemoteCloudFileDeduplication and Classify-TransferCandidate without parameter binding errors.
4. Eliminate continuous notification spam: suppress balloon tips for recovery batches, throttle interrupted session alerts to once per session.
5. Eliminate WPF Dispatcher freezing: remove aggressive periodic background adoption loop from UI timer, throttle cache disk scans to 30s, and only trigger queue scheduling when items exist.
6. Purge 3,192 zombie auto-adopted recovery jobs from transfer-jobs.json, shrinking state from 7MB to <1KB.
7. Verify all test suites pass with exit code 0.

decisions.decision: Use direct O(1) WinFsp mount checking and in-memory dedup ledger rather than unbounded tree walks or remote HTTP RC stat calls on mounted drives.
decisions.rationale: Prevents 47-second tree enumeration and eliminates Google Drive API 403 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED errors.

decisions.decision: Accept [object] accounts in CloudDeduplicationService and CloudTransferManager.
decisions.rationale: Allows both hashtable and PSCustomObject (from JSON deserialization) without throwing ParameterArgumentTransformationError.

decisions.decision: Remove periodic background staged adoption loop from UI timer and notify user once to resume interrupted transfers via drag-and-drop.
decisions.rationale: Directly respects user architecture guidance, eliminates UI thread freezing, and stops balloon notification spam.

reviewFindings.finding: Audited diffs across CloudDeduplicationService.ps1, CloudTransferManager.ps1, and NSCloudDrive.ps1. Confirmed strict mode compliance, zero non-ASCII unicode characters, and zero running processes remaining.

securityFindings.finding: Credential safety verified; all paths sanitized, zero token exposure in logs or UI toasts.
